name: flight
description: Helicopter flight training — 1000 days compressed. Trinity's special.

modules.content: A helicopter's main rotor generates lift through angle of attack. Collective pitch changes all blades equally. Cyclic pitch varies blade angle through rotation for directional control. The tail rotor counteracts torque.
When engine fails, disengage clutch immediately. Upward airflow through rotor maintains RPM. Flare at 50ft to reduce descent rate. Airspeed ~65kt for optimum glide ratio ~4:1.

Attitude indicator shows pitch and roll. Heading indicator for direction. Altimeter for altitude. VSI for rate of climb/descent. Turn coordinator for bank angle. Scan pattern: attitude → altimeter → heading → repeat.

Engine failure: collective down, cyclic forward, identify landing zone, mayday call, flare at 50ft, cushion landing. Tail rotor failure: reduce power, autorotate if necessary. Hydraulics failure: manual controls, increased force required.
